recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin stain）下，黑色細纖維呈細密網格狀包圍幾乎每一顆腫瘤細胞，細胞核間距均勻、細胞質淡而寬，這種瀰漫性網狀纖維增加正是毛細胞白血病骨髓「乾抽（dry tap）」的原因。
features: Diffusely increased reticulin fibers forming a fine meshwork around individual cells
Evenly spaced round to oval nuclei separated by abundant pale cytoplasm
Dense fiber condensation adjacent to the bony trabecula
No collagen bundles evident; normal hematopoietic cells not discernible in this field
Bony trabecula at lower left and fat/vessel at upper left
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin shows a diffuse increase in fine reticulin fibers that form a delicate network surrounding individual cells, with focal condensation along the bony trabecula. The intervening cells have round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm, imparting a spaced-out pattern. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not apparent in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia with increased reticulin fibrosis (approximately MF-2), which explains the frequent dry tap on aspiration.

ddx.vs: PMF shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis with clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, rather than a uniform infiltrate of spaced-out mononuclear cells that are CD20+/annexin A1+.
Hairy cell infiltrates can mimic hypocellularity on H&E, but reticulin is increased and CD20 highlights the diffuse interstitial B-cell infiltrate.
SMZL forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates with less reticulin fibrosis and is annexin A1-negative, BRAF V600E-negative.
Mastocytosis shows paratrabecular spindle-cell aggregates with fibrosis that are tryptase/CD117+, not an interstitial CD20+ infiltrate.
